title: Venezuelan Bean Salad
description: A hearty, flavorful salad inspired by Venezuelan cuisine, featuring beans, sprouts, and a variety of textures.

ingredients.name: sprouts
ingredients.notes: any type of sprouts, such as alfalfa or broccoli

instructions: In a large bowl, combine the cooked black beans, sprouts, and yummy greens salad mix.
In a small bowl, whisk together the veggie oil, lime juice, salt, and pepper.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Thinly slice the red onion and add it to the salad.
Toss the salad again to distribute the onion.
Season with additional salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the salad chilled or at room temperature.
